cards.name: record_payment_view
cards.spec: record_payment_view(request, pk) records a payment for the sale with that pk. Read the posted field amount with Decimal; an invalid amount (not a number) shows messages.error('Enter a valid amount.') and creates nothing. Otherwise call record_payment(sale, amount) from sales.services; it raises ValueError for an unconfirmed sale or amount <= 0, then show the error text with messages.error. On success show 'Payment recorded.' Always redirect to sales:list. Only POST is allowed.
